lines.lyric: Nan sumshwigo shipeo i bami shireo
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 숨쉬고 싶어, 이 밤이 싫어 (이 밤이 싫어)
lines.lyric_translation: I want to breathe, I hate this night

lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 깨고 싶어, 꿈속이 싫어 (꿈속이 싫어)
lines.lyric_translation: I want to wake up, I hate this dream

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 안에 갇혀서, 난 죽어있어 (난 죽어있어)
lines.lyric_translation: I’m trapped inside of myself and I’m dead
Don’t wanna be lonely
Just wanna be yours

lines.lyric: Wae iri kkamkkamhan geonji niga eopneun i goseun
lines.lyric_hangul: 왜 이리 깜깜한 건지 니가 없는 이 곳은?
lines.lyric_translation: Why is it so dark where you’re not here
It’s dangerous how wrecked I am

lines.lyric: Guhaejwo nal nado nal jabeul su eopseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 구해줘 날 나도 날 잡을 수 없어 수없어
lines.lyric_translation: Save me because I can’t get a grip on myself
Listen to my heartbeat
It calls you whenever it wants to
Because within this pitch black darkness
You are shining so brightly

lines.lyric: Geu soneul naemireojwo save me save me
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 손을 내밀어줘, save me, save me
lines.lyric_translation: Give me your hand save me save me

(Please save me tonight
Please save me tonight)
Within this childish madness
You will save me tonight
I knew that your salvation
Is a part of my life
And the only helping hand that will embrase my pain
